approval_basis: The user approved the 70 manual-review entries, then approved the remaining 70 candidates and requested careful verification.

interpretation_notes.electricity: Grid electricity and generator electricity retain the approved category keys as labels for public/city supply and private generation/generator source categories. They do not establish grid connection, provider ownership, off-grid status, or generator technology.
interpretation_notes.other: Other remains a field- and wave-specific residual. Equal category names do not imply identical residual contents across waves.
interpretation_notes.compound_fuels: Firewood and charcoal, gas and electricity, and kerosene or diesel remain separate from each component category; do not split their frequencies.
interpretation_notes.none: Lighting None and cooking None/don't cook are substantive responses in different fields, not missingness reasons.
interpretation_notes.encoding: The 2019 cooking label None/don?t cook retains its exact source spelling; the approved alias only normalizes the displayed category.
interpretation_notes.draft: The 20 selected 2014 rows retain provisional questionnaire provenance despite semantic approval.
interpretation_notes.skip: Retain all 46 selected skip annotations. Category acceptance does not determine eligibility or an analytical denominator.
interpretation_notes.code_nine: 2016 lighting code 9 is Biogas; 2021 lighting code 9 is Other. The corrected 2004 missing sentinel is excluded from this category release.
interpretation_notes.no_technology_inference: Source categories do not by themselves define clean fuel, renewable energy, or an access indicator. Such derived classifications require an analytical definition.

publication_design.value_role: Auxiliary semantic dictionary for existing numeric source-code fields; no recoding of physical table values.
publication_design.history: Append a release-specific copy of each of the 21 effective source rules and attach 140 value mappings to those new identities. Keep existing source rules and correction provenance intact.
later_execution_steps: Version the implementation and all evidence in Git/DVC

Append the exact planned records, independently validate, and export the next lineage version
